title: AccessRightFields
description: Access right fields of a media content item.

oneOf.title: EU orphan work
oneOf.description: Protected Domain: In copyright – EU Orphan Work

oneOf.title: Unknown rightsholders
oneOf.description: Protected Domain: In copyright – Unknown rightsholders

rights_perm_use_explore_plain.title: Permission for Exploration
rights_perm_use_explore_plain.description: Permission level for exploratory use of the content (e.g. browsing, inspection, discovery).

rights_perm_use_get_tr_plain.title: Permission for Transcript Retrieval
rights_perm_use_get_tr_plain.description: Permission level for retrieving textual representations of the content.

rights_perm_use_get_img_plain.title: Permission for Image Retrieval
rights_perm_use_get_img_plain.description: Permission level for retrieving image representations of the content.

^rights_explore_b\\d+_b$.description: Individual bitmap position for exploration rights. Field name format: rights_explore_b{position}_b where position is the bit index (0-63). Only positions with value true are stored.

^rights_get_tr_b\\d+_b$.description: Individual bitmap position for text retrieval rights. Field name format: rights_get_tr_b{position}_b where position is the bit index (0-63). Only positions with value true are stored.

^rights_get_img_b\\d+_b$.description: Individual bitmap position for image retrieval rights. Field name format: rights_get_img_b{position}_b where position is the bit index (0-63). Only positions with value true are stored.

permittedUse.title: Permission level indicating how the content may be used.

oneOf.title: Personal, Research and Educational use
oneOf.description: Use permitted for personal activities, academic research, and educational purposes.

oneOf.title: Research and Educational use
oneOf.description: Use permitted for academic research and educational purposes.

oneOf.title: Research use
oneOf.description: Use permitted strictly for research purposes.

oneOf.title: No usage restriction
oneOf.description: No restrictions apply to the use of the content.

oneOf.title: Operation not permitted
oneOf.description: Use of the content is not permitted.
